title: What information extraction does · Level 3
slo: Identify what AI-powered information extraction turns into structured data.

exercises.question_text: Information extraction is best described as what kind of AI work?

options.text: A workload that extracts data from content
options.rationale: Information extraction is an AI workload. It combines techniques to obtain data from content.

options.text: A method that only detects text
options.rationale: Text detection is one component of an extraction solution. The workload also identifies and organizes relevant values.
options.better_fit: Text detection is appropriate for the OCR stage of an extraction process.

options.text: A method that only assigns fields
options.rationale: Field assignment is one component of the broader workload. Content must also be extracted before it can be assigned.
options.better_fit: Field assignment is appropriate after text or values have already been extracted.

options.rationale: A database stores values after processing. An information extraction workload obtains those values from content first.
options.better_fit: A database storage service fits the destination for structured values after extraction.

exercises.explanation: Correct. It is a broader AI workload, not one isolated step.

exercises.question_text: Which are examples of unstructured media for AI information extraction? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Documents can contain content without a fixed schema. They are common extraction inputs.
Images can contain visual text and other extractable content. They are unstructured media inputs.
Audio recordings contain unstructured spoken content. Speech recognition can prepare that content for extraction.
Labeled fields are organized extraction results. They are not the source media being processed.
options.better_fit: Labeled data fields fit as the stored output of extraction.

exercises.explanation: Correct. These media can provide unstructured content.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The workload's common input type would be misidentified.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Database tables store already structured data, whereas digital documents commonly supply content to process.

exercises.explanation: Digital documents are a frequent source of content for information-extraction workloads.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The claim would attempt to use values before they were available.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Follow the dependency from receipt text to identified values to mapped claim fields.

exercises.correct_answer: Extract receipt text identify relevant values map values to claim fields
exercises.explanation: Text must be extracted before relevant values can be identified and mapped to fields.

exercises.question_text: What does AI information extraction create from unstructured media?

options.rationale: It produces labeled, organized values from unstructured content. Business systems can store and use those values.

options.error_type: Confuses text reading with complete extraction
options.rationale: OCR can read visible words but does not assign them to business fields. Extraction produces structured values with meaning.
options.better_fit: OCR is appropriate when searchable or editable text is the only required output.

options.error_type: Confuses an approach with the output
options.rationale: Templates can help locate values in known layouts. They are not the labeled values produced by extraction.
options.better_fit: Templates fit standardized forms with consistent locations for fields.

options.error_type: Confuses a processing step with the output
options.rationale: Semantic mapping assigns a value to a field during extraction. It is not the finished collection of labeled data values.
options.better_fit: Semantic mapping fits the step that determines which field an extracted value represents.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The output is structured, labeled data fields.

exercises.question_text: Which parts are used in a comprehensive extraction solution? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Computer vision detects text in image-based data. That text can then be mapped to fields.

options.text: Machine learning to map text to fields
options.rationale: Machine learning can semantically map text to fields. Mapping identifies what each value represents.

options.text: Generative AI to map text to fields
options.rationale: Generative AI can also perform semantic mapping. It can assign extracted text to meaningful fields.

options.error_type: Confuses automated extraction with manual entry
options.rationale: A comprehensive extraction solution automates text detection and field mapping. Manual review may occur, but copying every value is not the core method.
options.better_fit: Manual validation is appropriate for checking critical extracted values.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Detection is followed by semantic mapping to fields.

exercises.question_text: Expense-claim processing can extract relevant fields from ___.

parts.text: Expense-claim processing can extract relevant fields from

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The needed reimbursement details would come from the wrong source.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Expense claims use receipt values, whereas business cards and contracts support other scenarios.

exercises.explanation: Receipts provide the values that an expense-claim solution identifies and maps.

exercises.question_text: Semantic mapping detects visual text in an image before assigning it to a field.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A value would be assigned before its text had been identified.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Computer vision and OCR detect text; semantic mapping assigns it to a field.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Visual text is detected before semantic mapping assigns its field meaning.

exercises.question_text: What can a simple information-extraction app read from a business-card photo?

options.rationale: A business-card photograph is a simple extraction use case. It supplies contact details printed on the card.
Invoice line items describe purchased goods or services. They are not the expected content of a business card.
options.better_fit: Invoice line items are appropriate for invoice-processing workloads.

options.rationale: Termination clauses are legal contract terms. A business-card photo is used for contact details instead.
options.better_fit: Termination clauses are appropriate targets in legal-document processing.

options.rationale: Reimbursement totals are values found on receipts for expense claims. Business cards instead contain details for contacting someone.
options.better_fit: Receipt totals are appropriate for an expense-claim extraction solution.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Business-card photos can provide contact information.

exercises.question_text: Which technique identifies spoken content in an audio recording?

options.rationale: Speech recognition identifies spoken words in recordings. Those words can then be used for extraction.

options.error_type: Confuses spoken content with visual text
options.rationale: OCR detects text visible in images. It does not identify speech in audio.
options.better_fit: OCR is appropriate for scans, photographs, and other images containing text.

options.rationale: Semantic mapping assigns already extracted content to fields. It does not first recognize spoken words.
options.better_fit: Semantic mapping is appropriate after content has been extracted and needs field meaning.

options.error_type: Confuses visual analysis with speech recognition
options.rationale: Computer vision analyzes image-based content, including visible text. It does not identify the spoken words in an audio recording.
options.better_fit: Computer vision is appropriate for detecting text in image-based data.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Speech recognition handles spoken content.

exercises.question_text: A simple business-card app is designed to analyze and process financial and legal documents.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The simple card task would be confused with complex document processing.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Business cards provide contact information; financial and legal records support broader automation.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Financial and legal document processing is a more complex automation use.

exercises.question_text: Speech recognition can extend information extraction to ___.

parts.text: Speech recognition can extend information extraction to

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The relevant recording media would be left out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: The term names the media types whose spoken content can be identified.

exercises.explanation: Speech recognition makes spoken content in audio and video recordings available for extraction.
